results.summary: S&P 500 rose 1% hitting all-time intraday high; Nasdaq +1.1% also fresh all-time high; Dow +391 pts (+0.8%). Oil eased with WTI -4% to ~$101/barrel, Brent -3% to ~$109. US-Iran conflict backdrop. Job openings slipped to 6.87M in March, hiring rate sharply increased.
